component.name: Orbit Simulator
component.summary: Launch rockets from a turning Earth and see how orbits work

description.p: Orbit Simulator is for building an intuition for orbital mechanics. A rocket launches from anywhere on a rotating 3D Earth, at any date and time, and you see its path, its orbit and graphs of the flight.

ul.li: One to three stages, a payload, and an atmosphere with drag
Built-in flight plans, or your own list of burns and coasts
Sweep any setting to compare a whole family of flights side by side
Fly to the Moon, with the Sun and Moon where they really were
A guided demo tour and example scenarios to start from

screenshot.caption: A flight to low orbit from Cape Canaveral
